name: Beaumes de Venise

limits: Syrah and Mourvèdre together: at least 25%

climate: Grenache sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A southern Rhône Valley appellation for red wine only, recognized in 2005, made mainly from Grenache with at least 20 percent Syrah. The village also gives its name to Muscat de Beaumes-de-Venise, a separate appellation for sweet fortified vin doux naturel.
